description: OPC UA PubSub DataSetMessage representation. ADR 004: Renamed Source to Oi4Identifier for OPC compliance.

Oi4Identifier.description: OI4 Identifier of the data source. ADR 004: Renamed from 'Source' for OPC UA compliance. Contains the readable reference to the DataSetWriterId (8.1.6).

Filter.description: Optional filter value. In combination with the Oi4Identifier, contains the readable reference to the DataSetWriterId (8.1.7). Deprecated per ADR 004.

SequenceNumber.description: A strictly monotonically increasing sequence number assigned to the DataSetMessage by the DataSetWriter

Status.description: Optional and may not be shown, when status is "Good"

Payload.description: This object contains the name-value pairs specified by the PublishedDataSet.
